India to Play T20 Match Against Japan

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has announced that the Indian T20 team will play a match against Japan. The announcement was made by the BCCI, which also assured that the Indian team would face no difficulties in Japan. The specific occasion or context for this match was described as very special.
